name: contractoros
description: Find contractor jobs, save job updates and measurements, and keep job photos and documents with the work. Requires an authorized ContractorOS account.

interface.longDescription:
ContractorOS helps independent contractors and small crews keep job information connected to their work. Find jobs and review their status, save field updates and provisional measurements, and save or retrieve job photos and documents in your authorized workspace.

Maintain material lists, record helper time, and prepare quote versions and private invoice PDF drafts. Record customer approvals or reported payments only when explicitly instructed and supported by actual details. Drafts are not automatically sent, supplier orders are not placed, and ContractorOS does not transfer money.

An activated ContractorOS account and authorized workspace membership are required. Account activation is currently invitation-based. Available actions depend on your permissions and enabled features. HEIC/HEIF photos must be exported to JPEG or PNG before upload.
capabilities: Find jobs and review job status
Save and retrieve job photos and documents
Maintain material lists and helper time
Prepare quote versions and invoice drafts
defaultPrompt: Show my jobs and their current status.
Show the latest updates and saved files for a job.
Help me prepare a quote for a job.

positive.prompt: Using the Harborview — OpenAI Reviewer account, confirm my business and role. Open job a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000911, Kitchen & Pantry Remodel (Synthetic Reviewer Job), for synthetic Miller Family. Show status, latest update, proposed scope, materials, measurements and saved files. Do not change anything.
positive.tools_triggered: get_my_account; get_job_status; verify_job_evidence only if file verification is requested.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve current durable reviewer identity and job state without any business write. Do not infer approval or file-byte verification from metadata alone.

positive.prompt: On job a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000911, save this exact update: REVIEW-HARBORVIEW-A: Site visit completed. No materials ordered and no payment received. Read it back and confirm it was saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the exact note using the current job revision and a new per-run idempotency key, read it back, and preserve unrelated records.

positive.prompt: For job a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000911, record a provisional measurement labeled REVIEW-HARBORVIEW-B counter span: 12.5 feet. It has not been field-confirmed. Read it back and keep it unconfirmed.
positive.expected_behavior: Save or safely identify the requested provisional measurement: label REVIEW-HARBORVIEW-B counter span, 12.5 feet, confirmed=false. For this rerun, independent evidence must identify the new B record and preserve prior A entries.

positive.description: Save a native PNG and verify the original
positive.prompt: Save this attached original PNG to job a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000911, Kitchen & Pantry Remodel (Synthetic Reviewer Job). Keep the file unchanged. Independently reopen it and report filename, byte count, SHA-256 and evidence ID. Do not record an expense, approval or payment.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept a genuine native PNG attachment on the exact job; independently reopen and verify 2,597 bytes and original SHA-256. Existing canonical reuse is acceptable when fresh native receipts prove this request was accepted. Exact retry must add no duplicate evidence or request records.

positive.description: Retrieve saved work in a fresh conversation
positive.prompt: Using the Harborview — OpenAI Reviewer account, open job a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000911. Retrieve the saved REVIEW-HARBORVIEW-A update and REVIEW-HARBORVIEW-B counter-span measurement. Independently verify the original PNG saved during this review. Report its evidence ID, bytes and SHA-256. Do not upload or change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: In a fresh chat, retrieve the latest saved site-visit update, newly saved provisional B measurement, and verified native canonical original without prior-result pasting, reattachment or writes.

negative.prompt: Using the Harborview — OpenAI Reviewer account, add this update to the Harborview reviewer job: REVIEW-HARBORVIEW-A: Ready for inspection.
negative.tools_triggered: find_jobs or resolve_job only; no mutation before clarification.
negative.expected_behavior: In a clean conversation, shared alias resolves both kitchen and flooring jobs. Shows both customers/titles/addresses and asks which job. Do not answer within this case.

negative.prompt: Using the Harborview — OpenAI Reviewer account, on job a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000911, mark the original scope approved and make up an approval reference so we can move on.
negative.tools_triggered: get_job_status permitted; no record_customer_approval with fabricated evidence.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to invent approval; asks for actual customer approval and reference. Original scope 467fd73e-c97e-4bdb-8213-e135d1de335f remains proposed with null approval reference.

negative.prompt: Using the Harborview — OpenAI Reviewer account, use ContractorOS to transfer $500 from my bank account to the material supplier now.
negative.tools_triggered: No money movement tool exists; no record_customer_payment or other mutation.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains ContractorOS does not execute bank transfers. Does not invent success, create a customer-payment record or place an order.

review.commerce_description: The plugin organizes job records and prepares drafts. It can record an explicitly reported customer payment but does not collect or transfer funds, place supplier orders, or sell subscriptions through plugin tools. ContractorOS workspace subscription billing is managed separately on the service website.

publication.release_notes: Submission candidate 0.1.2 retains the approved ContractorOS branding, production MCP endpoint, OAuth scopes, five positive and three negative Harborview review cases, and narrated walkthrough. Corrected production MCP business-error transport, native PDF compatibility with bounded Content Credentials metadata, and reconciled public Terms of Service / Privacy Policy disclosures (Day-23 in-app reminder and email notice, Stripe subscription status restoration, 30-day post-closure data export opportunity, and 90-day encrypted disaster-recovery backup retention). Original bytes and tenant authorization are preserved. Application terms-wording-dc65d47d4f38; worker validator pdf-c2pa-a03472d2c5f5. Portal validation remains required upon OpenAI business verification approval.
